reading: Model A fits the evidence term controlling for the block (in-sample). Model B is the deployment-realistic test: the evidence model is fit on NEUTRAL blocks only, so it never sees the manipulation -- the independent evidence model a real device needs. The monitor (fraction of evidence-discordant choices toward the prior) and the governor (prior-pull reduction after reverting unjustified-toward-prior choices) are reported for both.
P2_specificity_note: The block prior is a fixed, state-independent (open-loop) manipulation, so the closed-loop flag is not expected to fire here; the justification monitor is the right detector. A real closed-loop (adaptive) manipulation would need optogenetic data, which is not reachable here.
